FL-A broke into CPAZI
B is a demand and held price up several time and also pushed price to engulf CPAZ2 and created FL-C
D is an FL that broke into CPAZ5 and held price
E is an FL that broke into CPAZ3 and then purhsed price to engulf FL-C
I thought the engulf of FL-C is a signal that price wants to go down so I am looking for short at FL-D, and there's better place to short than the MPL!?
After breaking FL-C, price created CPAZ4, and then spiked up to engulf FL-E, touched FL-D and drop back back to C AZ4
My mistake (on hindsight), is that I did NOT pay attention to price.
I thought I saw a BSZ (Green ellipse) and say yeah, I am going to get you!
Short here and lost
But price shot up strongly from the PCP, so I lost 1% of my account in few seconds.
LESSON LEARNED:
Read price carefully, if after forming that BSZ, price drop and engulf at least the PCP
then it might be a different outcome.

FL-A به CPAZI نفوذ کرد
B یک تقاضا و قیمت نگهداشته شده چندین بار است و همچنین قیمت را به سمت CPAZ2 فرو برده و FL-C ایجاد کرده است.
D یک FL است که به CPAZ5 نفوذ کرد و قیمت را نگه داشت
E یک FL است که به CPAZ3 نفوذ کرد و سپس قیمت را برای FL-C فرو برد.
فکر می‌کردم غرق شدن FL-C سیگنالی است که قیمت می‌خواهد پایین بیاید، بنابراین من به دنبال خرید کوتاه در FL-D هستم، و جای بهتری نسبت به MPL وجود دارد.
پس از شکستن FL-C، قیمت CPAZ4 ایجاد کرد، و سپس به بالا آمد تا FL-E را در بر بگیرد، FL-D را لمس کرده و به C AZ4 برگردد.
اشتباه من (از نظر گذشته) این است که به قیمت توجه نکردم.
فکر کردم یک BSZ (بیضی سبز) دیدم و گفتم آره، می‌خواهم تو را بگیرم!
اینجا کوتاه آمد و گم شد
اما قیمت به شدت از PCP بالا رفت، بنابراین من 1٪ از حساب خود را در چند ثانیه از دست دادم.
درس آموخته شده:
اگر پس از تشکیل آن BSZ، قیمت کاهش یافته و حداقل PCP را در بر بگیرد، قیمت را با دقت بخوانید

82cc2893d7e892f6702d397a4f4add0665595217.textOriginal:
In general, we enter trades at KINKS, which include DP, FL, PCP and ECP.
It's ALWAYS advisable to trade kinks that aligned with an LS or SSR or BOTH.
LSK is just a kink that aligns with an LS level. This kink does not have to be the FIRST KINK but if it is
then all the better.
SRK is just a kink that aligns with an SSR. Again, this kink does not have to be the FIRST KINK but if it
is then all the better.
A Kink that has broken into CPAZ is very reactive when price returns to it.
A hidden SRK (only visible on extremely Iow timeframe) inside a huge ERC (Pole) can offer very high RR.
No matter how perfect your kink is, it can still fail, and when it does fail, it becomes an IGNORED LEVEL,
and this is very reactive when price returns. Do not walk away from a failed trade, instead, look for the
new kink (swapped FL) that is created, anticipate that price will retrace to this swapped FL and trade it
like a boss!
Finally, we trade CONTRARIAN — identify levels with strong magnetic attraction and trade towards it.
82cc2893d7e892f6702d397a4f4add0665595217.textPersian:
به طور کلی، ما وارد معاملات در KINKS می شویم که شامل DP، FL، PCP و ECP است.
همیشه توصیه می شود که شخصیت های تجاری را که با LS یا SSR یا BOTH هماهنگ شده اند، معامله کنید.
LSK فقط یک خویشاوند است که با سطح LS هماهنگ می شود، این کینک نباید اولین KINK باشد، اما اگر آن را
سپس همه چیز بهتر است.
SRK فقط یک خویشاوند است که با SSR دوباره هماهنگ می شود، این کینک نباید اولین KINK باشد، اما اگر آن را به عنوان اولین KINK اما اگر آن را
پس بهتر است.
یک کینک که به CPAZ شکسته شده است، زمانی که قیمت به آن باز می گردد، بسیار واکنش پذیر است.
یک SRK پنهان (فقط در چارچوب زمانی بسیار Iow قابل مشاهده است) در داخل یک ERC بزرگ (Pole) می تواند بسیار بالا (0) ارائه دهد.
مهم نیست که شخصیت شما چقدر عالی است، هنوز هم می تواند شکست بخورد و وقتی شکست بخورد، به یک IGNORED LEVEL تبدیل می شود.
و این بسیار واکنش پذیر است وقتی که قیمت بازگشت می کند، از یک تجارت شکست خورده دور نشوید، به جای آن، به دنبال آن بگردید.
خویشاوند جدید (ترجمه شده) که ایجاد شده است، پیش بینی می کند که قیمت به این FL مبادله شده و تجارت آن را دوباره گسترش می دهد.
مثل یک رئیس!
در نهایت، ما CONTRARIAN را تجارت می کنیم - سطوح با جاذبه مغناطیسی قوی و تجارت به سمت آن را شناسایی می کنیم.

09ac83b11b08051fad18539c55cb5d5ddc640087.textOriginal:
At the base of a long Pole
Ignored Level (trade the new Swapped FL)
ontrarian (only if you are orn in Jupiter)
In general, we enter trades at KINKS, which include DP, FL, PCP and ECP
It's ALWAYS advisable to trade kinks that aligned with an LS or SSR or BOTH.
LSK is just a kink that aligns with an LS level. This kink does not have to be the FIRST KINK but if it is
then all the better.
SRK is just a kink that aligns with an SSR. Again, this kink does not have to be the FIRST KINK but if it
is then all the better.
A Kink that has broken into CPAZ is very reactive when price returns to it.
A hidden SRK (only visible on extremely low timeframe) inside a huge ERC (Pole) can offer very high RR.
No matter how perfect your kink is, it can still fail, and when it does fail, it becomes an IGNORED LEVEL,
and this is very reactive when price returns. Do not walk away from a failed trade, instead, look for the
new kink (swapped FL) that is created, anticipate that price will retrace to this swapped FL and trade it
like a boss!
•nally, we trade CONTRARIAN — identify levels with strong magnetic attraction and trade towards it.

Comments:
The switch FLS in this drawing are the Long/Short Switch from long to
short or vice versa.
Engulfing FL I means that eventually, price will fill the price range from FL
A to FL C (since FL C was the last short origin FL). Inside the PAZ (PAZ I)
which is created between FTR of FL A and FTR of FL C, price will zigzag its
Origin FL - Also Target FL for the shorts from the top origin FL (FL B)
way to the ETR of FL C.
After reaching FTR or MPL of FL C, if price didnt engulf up through FL C,
then when price breaks below FL 2, ITS signal each other that they
eventually want FTR of FL A below.
A new PAZ is then created between the FTR of FL B and FTR of FL A. Price
will then zigzag its way again, using manipulations of fear and hope, from
FTRof FL B to FTR/MPL of FL A.
Symmetry is, therefore, a byproduct of these movements of ITS filling
PAZs. That is to say a movement down from an OREL to a target FL, when
proper PA/enguIf is given at the switch FLs, will be matched with a similar
move up to the same OREL from the previous target FL.

Lets say we have this scenario: Price reacted from A (but not from its
MPL so we have fresh orders above). On the way down, price hit the MPL
of B, so basically we have no PA in higher scale. So we can't trade in this
higher scale yet, but we want something in lower scale. Lets say we want
to trade C. We know that there are clean orders at much higher prices
but this is a very high scale. We set a BSZ at the green dotted
line. Since our BSZ its already in the kink, how would you proceed with
this? We know we have multiple fresh orders inside a kink and we want
to TT them back to asz. NOW.
1) If price would hit 1 and after that it will retrace back to the BSZ,
would you consider the entire kink gone? Y/N
2) If you want to trade at 1 where would you put the SL, since you dont
want a too hard SL? Would you put your hard SL above 2 or 3 knowing
that since 1 is broken you'll have the possibility to retrace from the clean
orders inside 2 back to the former MPL of 1 and you can exit without any
loss, or would you still keep the hard SL above the entire kink C?
3) Lets say you want to enter at 5. This seems to be the absolute MPL
inside of C. You'll still need a hard SL on this to give you a possibility to
get out without any loss if the entire level fails. But where would be your
hard SL? In most of the cases D seems to far, so would you prefer to put
your SL above the next little IQM or something in lower scale? Y/N
4) If you want to TT trade at 5, where will be your first target? I know

How is a Flag Limit Created?
Salivan's Definition
Key SR
FTR not yet an FL
Confirmed FL
Automatically = Confirmed FL (also Swapped FL)
EG
There is a difference between FTR and FL.
VI'R is created after the break of a significant SR (not FL).
However, we should pay more attention to FTRs that have held price.
"Confirmed FL" is FT R that has held price, and
FTR now = Confirmed FL
"Swapped FL" is created after engulfing a confirmed FL.
We can then trade the FL* on FTB (FL as entry point), or
We can also use FL as target.
*In the future when we use the word FL, we mean 'confirmed' FL.

understand that failure is an event, not a
person, that yesterday ended last night, and

friends with your past, are focused on the
present, and are optimistic about your future.

God-given physical, mental and spiritual
abilities to the glory of God and for the benefit
of mankind.
You may have made some mistakes,

to be, but that has NOTHING to do
with your future!»

Price react at kink B, but in the same time it reacted at the bigger kink A.
Before price hit B, but not it's MPL and create a BS. Where should i sell and
how can i manage to put my SL in this case? I see a lot of the time when
price react at the MPL of B, back to BS and after that the MPL of A it doesn't
hold anymore. So, if i try to enter at MPL of B with a SL just above B, the
entire B can still be BS for the MPL of A. If i try to enter at the MPL of A, i
can be wrong again.

Price Engulf یک PAZ بین دو خط قرمز و ما می خواهیم یک retrace قبل از قیمت پایین است، در حال حاضر قوانین خاصی برای اینکه چقدر تا به حال وجود دارد.
قیمت قبل از اینکه به هدف ضربه بزند، دوباره به رقابت می پردازد.اگر گفت که و من سعی کردم که آنچه را که او به آن معنی می دهد، رمزگشایی کنم.
قیمت می تواند تمام راه را تا 1 قبل از آن که به مدت کوتاهی نشان داده شده PA را مجدداً تکرار کند، اما ما می توانیم تمام این سطوح (4,3,2,1) را معامله کنیم.
این سطوح اهداف خاصی دارند (خط سبز زیر هر سطح) تصور کنید که در VLTF دیگر FL وجود دارد.
محدودیت برای PAZS در حال حاضر قوانین خاص به دستور تا پر شده و در آن سفارشات غیر پر شده باقی مانده است.
آنچه که من تمایل به انجام آن دارم این است که در VLTF برای سطوح X در داخل QMs صبر کنم.هر FL (1,2,3,4) باید در سطح X باشد.
که از سطح QM و چهار تشکیل شده است که می تواند دیگر QM در مقیاس عاشق باشد.

what of these flags the price has to test?

means buyers want to check on how many
strong sellers. If sellers strong, then they set the
price to the new formed flag, meaning that there
IS a lot of sellers. Buyers will understand it and
will recede at the following attack to sellers.

I was thinking lately about flags and poles and FTRs. Pole is fast move - institutional orderflow.
Price breaks something. Then ITS hide their orders on retrace. It is phase "A".
When ITS have all orders filled they begin phase "B" (pole) - they have orders filled so they take price to the next IVI
and they will close their positions in profit at higher price - next phase. It will present itself on the chart
as a FLAG. In flag they can also add more positions instead of closing, and take price further in their direction.

Right. To answer a PM I got, which was
"Is there any way to know how tar will the retrace will happen after the break of the level?"
No.lt can retrace to any set ot clean orders in the zone it's traveled through.
Ideally it will travel all the way back for a QM at the MPL, or even break the HIL for a DM, but it otten only retraces a snort way,
leaving the clean orders beyond for later.
At each minor level it retraces to, we can take confirmed LTF trades, taking some profits to cover losses, letting some run to the
HTF target, should this be the depth ot the RT

نه.lt می تواند به هر گونه دستور تمیز تنظیم شده در منطقه که از طریق آن سفر می شود، مجدداً اعتراض کند.
